Can you add what this will be used for?
Sure yeah! Done
Done
If this is the goal "CPLD" is too general of a Type name.  "<name of update protocol>CPLD" is the format we should be using, so we can omit the "part" key entirely
@Daniel-Hsu@quantatw.com Can you please help resolve this comment by changing the type to I2CCPLD.

I2CCPLD isn't really specific enough either.  The CPLD supports a specific type of interface, even proprietary ones.  Lets make sure that's clear here.

As an example, I doubt that Maxim and Altera CPLDs both support the same update protocol.  This as written would imply that they do.

> I2CCPLD isn't really specific enough either.  The CPLD supports a specific type of interface, even proprietary ones.  Lets make sure that's clear here.
> 
> As an example, I doubt that Maxim and Altera CPLDs both support the same update protocol.  This as written would imply that they do.

Sure, makes sense. I think it can be achieved with 
"Type": { enum : ["AlteraCPLD", "LatticeCPLD"] }

And the description should be updated to reflect the appropriate wording.
Done
Altera and Lattice are companies that make a lot of CPLDs with varying degrees of features.  Is there something more specific about the actual protocol we can use in the name?

How about including chip family, making it <vendor name><update protocol family>CPLD.
likes "Type": { enum : ["LatticeXO5CPLD", "LatticeXO2XO3CPLD"] }
Done
These wouldn't be a new schema, these would be gpio definitions in the existing schema.  But regardless, can probably just be removed from this commit message.
@Daniel-Hsu@quantatw.com Can you please update the commit message to reflect the requested change.
Done

Let's add to the description which repos will use this configuration schema.

I did this for some of the legacy schemas, and i think it will help to keep an overview as more schemas are introduced

e.g.
```
  "ChassisIntrusionSensor": {
            "description": "implemented in dbus-sensors: ChassisIntrusionSensor",
```
Already mentioned by @ed@tanous.net not to add this on https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/77198/comment/c2885470_436befa1/. Hence, marking this as resolved.

Can add 
```
"additionalProperties": false,
```
here
Done

```Type``` field should be enum or const value.

Otherwise it would be possible for 2 unrelated schemas to collide in the future, leading to validation problems.

Having an enum for ```Type``` will help to easily grep which schema a configuration record belongs to.
Done

Can add
```
"required": ["Name", "Type", "Bus", "Address", "Part"],
```

At least Name and Type should be required. I would prefer all properties to be required.
Done
